title: Logan Paul has listed his 78-acre California ranch with an extraordinary past for sale at $3 million
summary_full: Logan Paul has put his notorious California ranch on the market for three million dollars. Once the base for Timothy Leary's LSD operation, this secluded 78-acre property boasts an off-grid retreat experience. Acquired by Paul in 2019, the ranch has seen numerous enhancements. Speculation suggests he may now shift his real estate focus to Puerto Rico.
